name: Perspective AI
description: An AI Concierge replaces static forms with adaptive AI conversations that understand real situations, capture structured data automatically, and trigger the right next step. Rigid forms cause drop-off, miss context, and weaken qualification. With Perspective, your AI assistant can design conversation agents (Concierge, Interviewer, Evaluator, Advocate), invite participants, analyze responses with trust scoring, and wire automations to Slack, HubSpot, Gmail, or webhooks — all without leaving the chat.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Perspective AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Perspective AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://getperspective.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Perspective AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Perspective AI lists 32 MCP tools, including automation_create, automation_delete, automation_list, automation_test, automation_update, integration_manage, participant_invite, perspective_await_job, perspective_create, perspective_get, perspective_get_conversation, and perspective_get_conversations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Perspective AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Perspective AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Perspective AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Perspective AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Perspective AI is developed by Perspective AI. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
